user_scope_preference.requested_scope: Return the bok choy ingredient's nutrition without adding cooking oil to the calculation.
user_scope_preference.working_assumption: Ingredient-only means cooking additions are not included; only added oil was explicitly named by the user, so salt/sauce treatment should remain a visible scope assumption rather than a measured omission.
user_scope_preference.display_boundary: Ingredient-only reference; must not be labelled as complete stir-fried dish nutrition.
user_scope_preference.portion_weight_boundary: Raw per-100g data cannot be multiplied by estimated cooked grams as an exact result. A raw-equivalent mass or a separately reviewed no-added-fat cooked record is needed for portion scaling.

help_center_observations: Official Tavily Help Center says customer-facing applications may have end users trigger searches through the developer's backend.

The same article says personal projects and the free Researcher plan are allowed, including commercial/production use; keep keys server-side, do not give end users direct API access, and do not resell the API.
Official Governing Terms FAQ says API use is governed by the Platform Terms and uses outside those terms need a signed agreement or express written permission.
platform_terms_observations: Platform Terms dated 2026-05-04 grant API use for the customer's internal business purposes.

The Terms separately contemplate customer applications with third-party end users, but the internal-business-purpose limitation is not explicitly reconciled with the newer Help Center customer-app guidance.
tavily_scope_review.decision: The free plan and server-proxied customer-app pattern are explicitly supported by official Help Center guidance; an enterprise plan is not stated as a prerequisite. Do not describe the Platform Terms scope as fully reconciled or use this review as legal advice. Continue only bounded isolated technical tests under the existing user authorization. Before general public/production activation, record the applicable account terms or obtain a written scope clarification; keep the API key server-side and automatic fallback disabled.

next_gate: Keep any next Tavily/model call isolated and bounded; the official Help Center supports the free plan and backend-proxied customer-app pattern, while production/public activation waits for applicable terms scope to be documented.

Verify the AFCD F001301 raw and/or F001300 no-added-fat cooked primary-source records, applicable reuse terms, nutrient derivations and fixed-schema extraction; do not accept any download licence on the user's behalf.

Keep the result scope ingredient-only. The user explicitly excludes added cooking oil; do not estimate salt or sauces as part of the bok choy profile, and do not describe the result as complete prepared-dish nutrition.
Do not multiply a raw 100g profile by cooked image-estimated grams as if exact; require raw-equivalent mass or a separately reviewed cooked-state profile for portion scaling.
If an adapter-only test is run, classify it as source-format testing, not a valid photo/local-miss nutrition result; do not infer a vague image label from nutrition search.
Use a genuinely identified food and an unforced healthy TFDA/USDA miss before claiming an application-level Tavily fallback test.
